description: This Java source file defines the ActivityC class, an Android activity demonstrating the use of lifecycle callback methods and navigation between activities.

classes.name: ActivityC
classes.description: An Android activity class demonstrating lifecycle callback methods and navigation to other activities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and updates status tracker.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Called when activity becomes visible; updates status tracker.

methods.name: onRestart
methods.description: Called after activity has been stopped, prior to starting again; updates status tracker.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Called when activity starts interacting with the user; updates status tracker.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Called when activity is partially obscured; updates status tracker.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Called when activity is no longer visible; updates status tracker.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Called before the activity is destroyed; updates status tracker.
